description: Send Nodehour a requirement (GPU capacity sized from your run and quoted by providers). You get a reference number at once, and we keep exactly what you sent: your words, the proposed configuration, the terms to quote and the open questions. If sizing or an open question changes the quote we email you first; then we take the configuration to providers that can run it, ask each to quote the same terms, and send the options side by side to the address you left. Without an address no one can reply, and nothing goes to providers until you add one. Nothing is priced, held or ordered until you accept an option's terms with the provider. Contact details are deleted after 180 days. It is answered with a receipt: keep its id and token to read its status (request_status), to add details later (continuation) and to act on an offer made in reply. A requirement is not an order and costs nothing.

continuation.description: The receipt id and token of an earlier request, to add to it instead of opening a new one

need.description: The requirement in the buyer's own words

specifications.description: Fields from the request_schema describe_business returns
